name: scope

findings.message: The DSRACE-1 and DSRACE-7 test sections pipe into `/usr/bin/head -1` under `set -euo pipefail`, violating the explicit rule "never pipe into a bare head, in any .sh file, test files included"; the SIGPIPE guard does not catch it because it excludes `-test.sh` files from the `| head` scan and its regex matches `head` as a bare word, not `/usr/bin/head`.
findings.trigger: Under `set -euo pipefail` (line 5 of the file), if the call-sequence file ever contains more than one POST_NOTE or GET_NOTES entry — for example if a future test invokes the claim twice within a section before resetting — `head -1` exits early, `grep` receives SIGPIPE, the pipeline exits non-zero, and the assignment that uses it aborts the test script.
findings.accepted_if: Every loser run is never able to reach the stale-takeover path and the test assertions never produce lines from a pipeline that exits before the writer finishes.
